Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ElectroTech Solutions operates as a retail electronics store specializing in the sale of consumer electronics and providing technical repair services for various devices, including smartphones, laptops, and tablets. The store has been in business for over three years at its current location, showcasing operational stability and a strong understanding of local market conditions. In conjunction with sales, ElectroTech Solutions offers repair services that account for less than 25% of total revenue, ensuring compliance with underwriting guidelines. The business has implemented a professionally monitored alarm system to enhance security and mitigate theft risk associated with high-value inventory. With a balanced revenue stream, approximately 65% of sales are derived from in-store transactions, while 35% come from e-commerce, reducing overall cyber exposure. The company maintains a solid track record of low claims related to slip-and-fall incidents, contributing to its favorable underwriting evaluation.
